items.label: Accessory drive belt idler pulley bolt
items.note: For 4.2 cars JTIS gives 45 Nm in 303-01 and 40 Nm in 303-05. The 1999-2002 procedures quote 61 Nm, inside the table range. JTIS 303-01. The MY1997 procedure gives the same figure, so this covers all 4.0 cars.

items.label: Accessory drive belt idler pulley bolt
items.note: For 4.2 cars JTIS gives 45 Nm in 303-01 and 40 Nm in 303-05. The 1999-2002 procedures quote 61 Nm, inside the table range. JTIS 303-01.

items.label: Accessory drive belt tensioner bolt
items.note: The 1999-2002 procedures quote 43 Nm, inside the table range. JTIS 303-01. The MY1997 procedure gives the same figure, so this covers all 4.0 cars.

items.label: Accessory drive belt tensioner bolt
items.note: The 1999-2002 procedures quote 43 Nm, inside the table range. JTIS 303-01.

items.label: Lower cylinder block (bedplate) to upper block bolts
stages: Bolts 1 to 10 to 35 Nm plus 135 degrees
Bolts 11 to 20 to 20 Nm plus 150 degrees
Bolts 21 to 32 to 20 Nm plus 90 degrees
Bolts 33 to 34 to 20 Nm plus 150 degrees
items.sequence: Follow the stage order above with the bolt numbers in JTIS figure J0002450.
items.note: These are the main bearing fasteners: the engine has no separate main caps. Do not lubricate the bolts. Finish within twenty minutes of laying sealant (WSS-M4G320-A3 RTV). Make sure all dowels are seated. Do not turn the crank until all bolts are tightened. JTIS 303-01 Engine Assembly.

items.label: Camshaft bearing cap bolts
items.sequence: Fit caps in their numbered positions and pull down evenly, in stages, working across the caps.

items.label: Camshaft bearing cap bolts
items.sequence: Fit caps in their numbered positions and pull down evenly, in stages, working across the caps.

items.label: Camshaft (valve) cover bolts
items.sequence: Tighten in the sequence in the JTIS 303-01 cover procedure figure.
items.reuse: Bolts can be reused. Fit new sealing rings or O-rings on the bolts each time the cover comes off.

items.label: Camshaft (valve) cover bolts
items.sequence: Tighten in the sequence in the JTIS 303-01 cover procedure figure.
items.reuse: Bolts can be reused. Fit new sealing rings or O-rings on the bolts each time the cover comes off.

items.label: Camshaft sprocket / VCT unit bolts
items.reuse: Replace. Fit new bolts.
items.note: Three factory figures exist. The 2003-06 manual torque table and in-vehicle procedure give 20 Nm plus 90 degrees for both the intake sprocket and VCT sprocket centre bolts, and say new bolts must go in. JTIS 2004 in-vehicle procedure gives 70 Nm plus 90 degrees. Older assembly text, still printed in the same manual, gives 120 Nm. The latest figure is shown. Hold the chain tensioned on its drive side with the special tool.

items.label: Connecting rod bolts
items.reuse: Replace. JTIS calls for new bolts on the cap.
items.note: Quoted in the MY1997-98 Connecting Rod Bearings procedure and assumed for later 4.0 engines. JTIS 303-01.

items.label: Connecting rod bolts
items.reuse: Replace. Torque-to-yield; discard after removal.
items.note: Keep bearing slots and tangs on the same side of the rod. Rotate the crank afterwards to check it turns. JTIS 303-01 Engine Assembly.

items.label: Crankshaft damper bolt, damper with split locking ring
items.reuse: Replace. Fit a new bolt on final assembly.
items.note: Check for a split locking ring when the damper comes off. Fit the ring onto the crank inside the damper bore. JTIS 303-01.

items.label: Crankshaft damper bolt, damper without locking ring
items.reuse: Replace. Fit a new bolt.
items.threadlock: Thin coat of Loctite 648 on the damper bore only, not the end faces or crank. The bolt must be fully tightened within seven minutes.

items.label: Crankshaft pulley bolt
items.reuse: Replace. Discard the old bolt and clean out the thread in the crank before fitting a new one.
items.note: Spec table says 377 Nm, assembly procedure says 375 Nm. Hold the pulley with the special tools; never use crank setting peg 303-645 to lock the crank for this. JTIS 303-01.

items.label: Crankshaft position sensor bolt
items.note: Sections disagree: JTIS 303-01 lists 8-12 Nm for 1997-2002 and 10 Nm for 4.2 cars, while 303-14 lists 7 Nm from MY1999. JTIS 303-14.

items.label: Crankshaft position sensor bolt
items.note: Sections disagree: JTIS 303-01 lists 8-12 Nm for 1997-2002 and 10 Nm for 4.2 cars, while 303-14 lists 7 Nm from MY1999. JTIS 303-14.

items.label: Cylinder head bolts 11 and 12
stages: Final stage: bolts 11 and 12 to 25 Nm
items.sequence: The two smaller bolts at the front of the head, done last.
items.note: JTIS 303-01. The Vehicle Specifications book gives 23 Nm for the bolts marked Y, against 25 Nm in JTIS.

items.label: Cylinder head bolts, M10
stages: Stage 1: all M10 bolts in sequence to 20 Nm
Stage 2: all M10 bolts in sequence to 35 Nm
Stage 3: all M10 bolts in sequence a further 90 degrees
Stage 4: all M10 bolts in sequence a further 90 degrees
items.sequence: Start in the middle and work out. Left head, from the valley side, front to rear: 10, 6, 1, 3, 7. Outer side, front to rear: 8, 4, 2, 5, 9. The car shows these numbers.
items.reuse: Reusable on two occasions. Clean and inspect, and mark the bolt head with one centre-punch dot at each reuse. A bolt with two dots is replaced.
items.note: Fit hand tight first. Torque plus angle tightening; JTIS does not use the words torque-to-yield for these bolts but limits reuse as stated. JTIS 303-01.

items.label: Cylinder head bolts 1 to 10
stages: Stage 3: bolts 1 to 10 a further 90 degrees
Stage 4: bolts 1 to 10 a further 90 degrees
items.sequence: Start in the middle and work out, as on the 4.0. Left head, from the valley side, front to rear: 10, 6, 1, 3, 7. Outer side, front to rear: 8, 4, 2, 5, 9. The car shows these numbers.
items.reuse: Reusable on two occasions. Mark the bolt head with one centre-punch dot at each reuse. A bolt with two dots is replaced.
items.note: Reuse rule from the V8 cylinder head table in the Vehicle Specifications book. Same four stages there. Check dowels are seated before fitting the head. JTIS 303-01.

items.label: Cylinder head bolts, M8 (two at front of head)
stages: Stage 5: after the M10 bolts, tighten the two M8 bolts to 23-27 Nm

items.label: Oil level indicator tube nut
items.note: Fit a new O-ring seal. The MY2002 procedure gives 7 Nm. JTIS 303-01.

items.label: Drive plate (flexplate) to crankshaft bolts
items.sequence: Tighten in the order shown in the JTIS 303-01 flexplate figure. Wedge the ring gear to stop rotation.
items.reuse: Replace. JTIS warns that new drive plate bolts must be fitted.

items.label: Drive plate (flexplate) to crankshaft bolts
items.note: The 4.2 procedure gives no reuse instruction, unlike the 4.0 one, which demands new bolts. JTIS 303-01.

items.label: Exhaust camshaft sprocket bolt
items.note: Hold the chain tensioned on its drive side with tool 303-532 while tightening. JTIS 303-01.

items.label: Engine mounting bracket to block bolts
items.note: Factory tolerance is plus or minus 15 percent. JTIS 303-01.

items.label: Engine mount bracket to mount nuts
items.note: Factory tolerance is plus or minus 15 percent. JTIS 303-01.

items.label: Front engine mounting
items.note: JTIS 303-01 torque table entry, without a split by fastener. JTIS 303-01.

items.label: Engine mount lower bolt
items.note: Factory tolerance is plus or minus 15 percent. JTIS 303-01.

items.label: Engine mount upper nut
items.note: Factory tolerance is plus or minus 15 percent. JTIS 303-01.

items.label: Engine oil cooler pipe clamp / pipes to sump
items.note: Fit new O-ring seals on the pipes. JTIS 303-01.

items.label: Engine oil cooler pipe clamp / pipes to sump
items.note: Fit new O-ring seals on the pipes. JTIS 303-01.

items.label: Oil pan drain plug
items.reuse: Plug can be reused. Fit a new sealing washer every oil change (factory schedule item).
items.note: Also the figure to check on a new pan, which comes with the plug fitted. JTIS 303-01.

items.label: Oil pan drain plug
items.reuse: Plug can be reused. Fit a new sealing washer every oil change (factory schedule item).

items.label: Oil filter
items.note: TSB 303-51 replaced the old 15-18 Nm after filters loosened in service. Use filter wrench 303-752 and oil the filter gasket first. The bulletin makes the method mandatory at normal service. VSB 07/2004: 18 Nm exact.

items.label: Oil pan bolts
items.sequence: Eighteen bolts, tighten in the sequence shown in the JTIS 303-01 oil pan figure.
items.note: Bolt the pan on within twenty minutes of laying RTV sealant (Loctite 5699). JTIS 303-01.

items.label: Lower oil pan bolts
items.sequence: Tighten in the sequence shown in the JTIS 303-01 oil pan figure.

items.label: Oil pressure switch
items.threadlock: Small bead of Jaguar-specification sealant on the first three threads.
items.note: Connector retainer 2 Nm. Figure read from the MY2002 procedure. JTIS 303-01. Factory conflict: the V8 table in the Vehicle Specifications book gives 12 Nm.

items.label: Oil pump and strainer bolts
items.note: New gasket and new strainer O-ring. Figure read from the MY2002 oil pump procedure. JTIS 303-01.

items.label: Oil strainer bolts
items.note: New O-ring seal. JTIS 303-01 Engine Assembly.

items.label: Engine oil temperature sensor
items.note: JTIS 303-14. Factory conflict: the V8 table in the Vehicle Specifications book gives 20 Nm.

items.label: Primary chain tensioner blade pivot / guide bolt
Primary chain tensioner blade pivot / guide bolt
Timing (engine front) cover bolts
items.sequence: Tighten in the order shown in the JTIS 303-01 engine front cover figure.
items.note: 4.2 table also has a second line, "front engine cover retaining bolts 12 Nm"; the 4.2 assembly procedure uses 13 Nm. JTIS 303-01.

items.label: Timing (engine front) cover bolts
items.sequence: Tighten in the order shown in the JTIS 303-01 engine front cover figure.
items.note: 4.2 table also has a second line, "front engine cover retaining bolts 12 Nm"; the 4.2 assembly procedure uses 13 Nm. JTIS 303-01.

items.label: VVT bush carrier / oil control unit housing bolts and nut
VVT bush carrier / oil control unit housing bolts and nut
VVT solenoid bolt
items.note: JTIS 303-01 lists 10-14 Nm for 1999-2002 while 303-14 lists 10 Nm and the 2002 timing procedure says 8-10 Nm. 10 Nm satisfies all three. JTIS 303-01.

items.label: VVT solenoid bolt
items.note: JTIS 303-01 lists 10-14 Nm for 1999-2002 while 303-14 lists 10 Nm and the 2002 timing procedure says 8-10 Nm. 10 Nm satisfies all three. JTIS 303-14.

items.label: VVT solenoid bolt
items.note: JTIS 303-01 lists 10-14 Nm for 1999-2002 while 303-14 lists 10 Nm and the 2002 timing procedure says 8-10 Nm. 10 Nm satisfies all three. JTIS 303-14.

items.label: VVT unit to intake camshaft bolt
items.note: Hold the chain tensioned with tool 303-532 while tightening. JTIS 303-01.

items.label: VVT unit to intake camshaft bolt
items.note: Hold the chain tensioned with tool 303-532 while tightening. JTIS 303-01. Factory conflict: TSB 303-32 (3/99, VIN 031303 on, naturally aspirated) says 30-40 Nm and then 85-90 Nm. JTIS and a 2009 GTR print agree on 40 Nm plus 90 degrees. Never use the AJ26 figure of 115-125 Nm on this bolt.

Intake manifold to cylinder head bolts

items.label: Intake manifold to cylinder head bolts
items.note: Fit new port seals. The MY2002 procedure quotes 21 Nm, inside the table range. JTIS 303-01.

items.note: Tabulated only in the MY1998 dataset. No later 4.0 SC table carries it, so MY1999-2002 is assumed unchanged. JTIS 303-12.

items.label: Supercharger bolts
items.note: Factory figures disagree: 303-12 says 24 Nm, 303-01 table says 20 Nm, Engine Assembly says 22 Nm. The value shown is the dedicated supercharger section.

items.label: Supercharger outlet duct to supercharger
items.note: Fit new bolt seals where the procedure calls for them (4.2). JTIS 303-12.

items.label: Supercharger outlet duct to supercharger
items.note: Fit new bolt seals where the procedure calls for them (4.2). JTIS 303-12.

items.label: Supercharger outlet pipe to charge air cooler intake
Throttle body bolts
items.note: For 4.2 cars JTIS 303-04 lists 10 Nm while the 4.2 engine assembly procedure uses 20 Nm for the throttle body and elbow bolts. Check which you are fitting. JTIS 303-01, 303-04.

items.label: Throttle body bolts
items.note: For 4.2 cars JTIS 303-04 lists 10 Nm while the 4.2 engine assembly procedure uses 20 Nm for the throttle body and elbow bolts. Check which you are fitting. JTIS 303-04.

items.label: Throttle body elbow bolts, supercharged
items.note: 303-12 says 24 Nm; 303-01 says 20 Nm and the assembly procedure 22 Nm. Fit new bolt seals. JTIS 303-12.

items.label: Fuel feed pipe to rail bolts
Fuel rail (injection supply manifold) bolts
items.note: JTIS 303-14 lists 20 to 21 Nm for 1999-2002, against 12 Nm in 303-04. Treat 303-04 as the fuel section figure and check. JTIS 303-04.

items.label: Fuel rail (injection supply manifold) bolts
items.note: JTIS 303-14 lists 20 to 21 Nm for 1999-2002, against 12 Nm in 303-04. Treat 303-04 as the fuel section figure and check. JTIS 303-04.

items.label: Fuel rail to charge air cooler adaptor bolts
Knock sensor nut, MY1999 naturally aspirated
Spark plugs
items.threadlock: Nickel anti-seize on the thread: "Neverseez" ESE-M12A4-A (specified 1997-2002).

items.label: Spark plugs
items.threadlock: Nickel anti-seize on the thread: "Neverseez" ESE-M12A4-A (specified 1997-2002).

items.label: Charge air cooler radiator drain plug
Charge air cooler water pump bracket bolts
Coolant outlet pipe bolts, naturally aspirated
items.note: Fit new sealing rings in the pipe grooves. JTIS 303-01.

items.label: Cooling fan motor and shroud nuts
Radiator top securing panel
items.note: MY2002 radiator procedure says 8-10 Nm for the five panel bolts while 303-01 lists 22-28 Nm. Check which fastener is meant before tightening. JTIS 303-01.

items.label: Coolant filler plug, supercharged
items.reuse: Plug can be reused. Fit a new sealing washer.

items.label: Thermostat cover bolts
items.note: The ball valve must locate in the recess in the cover. JTIS 303-03.

items.label: Thermostat housing bolts
items.note: JTIS 303-01 and 303-12 say 10 Nm, 303-03 says 9 Nm. New O-ring seals. JTIS 303-01.

items.label: Water pump bolts
items.note: New gasket and O-ring. Applies to 4.0 and 4.2. Two owner videos tighten these bolts to a plain 13 Nm, with no source. All JTIS years and the 2003-06 manual say 8 Nm plus 90 degrees. JTIS 303-03.

items.label: Water pump pulley bolts
items.reuse: Replace. Discard the pulley bolts and fit new.
items.note: Hold the pulley with the special tool. JTIS 303-03.

items.label: Catalytic converter to front muffler nuts
items.note: 4.2 only. The 4.0 has no nuts at this joint: it is a slip joint with a Torca clamp. JTIS 309-00.

items.label: Over-axle mounting cradle to rear A-frame
Downpipe to bracket bolt
items.note: JTIS 309-00 lists 39-51 Nm and 303-01 lists 42-54 Nm for this joint, so 42-51 Nm fits both. JTIS 309-00.

items.label: Exhaust manifold to cylinder head bolts
items.reuse: 4.0: replace. Fit new bolts and new gaskets; each of the 8 bolts takes a spacer. 4.2: procedure does not call for new bolts.
items.note: On 4.0 cars clean the threads in the head with a plug tap before fitting. JTIS 303-01.

items.label: Exhaust manifold to cylinder head bolts
items.reuse: 4.0: replace. Fit new bolts and new gaskets; each of the 8 bolts takes a spacer. 4.2: procedure does not call for new bolts.
items.note: On 4.0 cars clean the threads in the head with a plug tap before fitting. JTIS 303-01.

items.label: Downpipe / catalytic converter to manifold nuts
items.reuse: 4.2: replace. Fit new nuts and a new gasket or heat shield gasket. 4.0: fit a new gasket; nuts not stated.
items.note: JTIS 309-00 lists 14-18 Nm and 303-01 lists 15-20 Nm for this joint, so 15-18 Nm fits both. An owner video quotes 60-80 Nm for these nuts, which is the Torca clamp row of the same table: no factory document gives it for these nuts. JTIS 309-00.

items.label: Downpipe / catalytic converter to manifold nuts
items.reuse: 4.2: replace. Fit new nuts and a new gasket or heat shield gasket. 4.0: fit a new gasket; nuts not stated.
items.note: JTIS 309-00 and the 2003-06 manual table and procedures all give 20 Nm.

items.label: Tailpipe mounting rubber support to body
Exhaust Torca clamps
items.note: Unresolved: Jaguar's own figures disagree. JTIS 309-00 lists 60-80 Nm and 303-01 lists 50-60 Nm, and only 60 Nm fits both. The exhaust section for the X308, another model, lists 52-68 Nm, which 60 Nm also fits. JTIS 309-00.

items.label: Exhaust Torca clamps
items.note: JTIS 309-00 and the 2003-06 manual agree on 50 Nm. The 4.0 clamps have their own figures.

items.label: Drive pinion flange nut
items.reuse: Replace. Discard the nut and peen the collar of the new nut to the pinion.
items.note: Tighten with the special tool, and check diff oil level afterwards, filling to the lower edge of the fill hole. JTIS 205-02.

items.label: Propshaft to final drive flange bolts
items.reuse: Always fit new nylon-insert nuts. Bolts can be reused if undamaged.
items.threadlock: Loctite 270 on the bolt threads. In production from VIN 022126, and applied to VIN 001001-022125 under Service Action S822.
items.note: Production figure 60 Nm from VIN 004855, which sits inside the JTIS range. Service Action S822 (VIN 001001-022125, cars without green paint on the nuts): Loctite 270 on the bolt threads and 67 Nm at the bolt, then a green paint stripe. JTIS 205-01.

items.label: Propshaft to final drive flange bolts
Propshaft to transmission flange / flexible coupling bolts
items.reuse: Always fit new nylon-insert nuts whenever these are loosened. Bolts reusable if undamaged.
items.note: The revised production figure is 78 Nm on both coupling faces, inside the 75-88 Nm range. The rear suspension refit procedure quotes 76-88 Nm for these bolts and calls for new coupling bolts and nuts in that procedure. JTIS 205-01.

items.label: Propshaft to transmission flange / flexible coupling bolts
items.reuse: Replace when refitting after rear suspension removal: JTIS calls for new coupling bolts and nuts in that procedure.
items.note: The rear suspension refit procedure quotes 76-88 Nm for these bolts. JTIS 205-01.

gaps: Main bearing (bedplate) bolt torque for the 4.0 AJ26/AJ27: not in any X100 or X308 JTIS dataset (they stop at rod bearings) and a web search found nothing. Not copied from the 4.2 figures.
JTIS 2.1 ends at MY2004. MY2005-2006 values are assumed to match MY2003-04; records with no myTo carry that assumption.
Torque-to-yield: JTIS only uses the phrase for 4.2 connecting rod bolts. 4.0 rod bolts must be new, but are not labelled TTY.

reuse is null where the procedure says nothing. JTIS section 100-00 still applies: microencapsulated patched fasteners (Jaguar spec JFS 02.01.02, part-number suffix M, and the listed JZS/JZB items) must be replaced after removal; prevailing-torque types (JFS 02.01.04) should go after the third removal.
Drive plate bolt reuse on the 4.2: procedures silent. Head bolt reuse is now answered by the Vehicle Specifications book: reusable twice.
Supercharger to engine bolts for 4.0 cars after MY1998: no table entry. 4.0 main supercharger pulley and bypass actuator figures not found.
Ball joint and wishbone reuse: no specific instruction found. Nyloc-type nuts follow the section 100-00 rule. The front hub rotor nut takes a new spring clip.
Final drive fill plug torque, block coolant drain plug torque, convertible top hydraulic fittings: not in JTIS tables.
lbft: converted from Nm at 0.7376 and rounded, because 1997-2002 tables give Nm only and some 2003 lb-ft columns are wrong (e.g. transmission mount shows 113).
Cross-check against bolidenforum.de: blocked by Cloudflare, so its figures were not used.
JTIS calls this box only the supercharged-vehicle automatic, so torque records say 5-speed supercharged. The W5A580 name comes from variants.json.
Where a Jaguar range is given, nm and lbft are strings such as "88-102". Single figures are numbers. Multi-step procedures have nm null unless a final torque exists, with the steps in stages.

Factory conflicts recorded in note with conf single: 4.2 camshaft sprocket bolts (20+90, 70+90, 120), rear caliper to hub carrier bolts (54-66 against 120-160), PAS pump bolts, rack bolts, AJ27 VVT bolt, oil pressure switch, oil temperature sensor, ZF 6HP26 mount bolts.
